validFrom.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. The pattern checks the month and day ranges; that the day exists in the month needs a "format": "date" check or the consumer's own. Where "$" accepts a trailing newline (Python), the consumer must reject one.

validTo.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. The pattern checks the month and day ranges; that the day exists in the month needs a "format": "date" check or the consumer's own. Where "$" accepts a trailing newline (Python), the consumer must reject one.
